raw_idea: I want an app that helps teachers track student progress

discover.core_problem: Teachers can't see which students need help until it's too late in the term.
discover.target_user: K-12 public school teachers managing 40+ students per class.
discover.context: Classroom settings where teachers rely on manual notes and sporadic assessments.
discover.core_value: Spot learning gaps before they become failures.

position.category: Student progress dashboard for K-12 teachers
position.differentiator: Proactive insight instead of reactive reports.
position.value_proposition: See every student's learning gaps and act before the next report.
position.competitive_angle: Plugs into existing LMS, surfaces the right student at the right time.

personality_traits.why: Teachers need a tool that feels approachable, not like another admin burden.
Used every morning, so it has to work.
No jargon. Teachers need to act fast, not interpret dashboards.

traits_to_avoid.why: Feels like another district procurement tool.
Teachers don't have time for cute.

naming_directions.name: SkillScope
naming_directions.rationale: Describes the exact job — seeing students' skill levels.

naming_directions.name: Pulsemark
naming_directions.rationale: Invented, warm, hints at pulse-checking student progress.

naming_directions.name: Lighthouse
naming_directions.rationale: Metaphor for spotting what's hidden in the dark.

shape.one_line_pitch: See which students need help today, without digging through spreadsheets.

visual.typography_direction: Clean sans-serif like Inter. Readable on classroom tablets.
visual.color_mood: Calm blue + warm orange on light gray. Example colors: #004E8C, #FF9F1C, #F5F5F5. Trustworthy but human.
visual.composition_notes: Card-based, generous whitespace, one big number per card.
visual.imagery_style: Flat icons only. No stock photos of smiling students.

launch.landing_headline: See every student's learning gaps at a glance
launch.subheadline: A free mobile dashboard that helps you act before the next report.
social_posts: I used to scramble for grades the night before a report. Now I get a clear snapshot of each student as soon as I open the app.
If you're a K-12 teacher with 40+ students, this is for you. See who needs help today, not last week.
No paperwork. No spreadsheets. Just the students who need you most.
